question.prompt: A track is 400 m per lap, and a straight section is 100 m long. What is the total length of the two bends? (One lap consists of two identical straight sections and two identical bends, with each straight section measuring 100 m; unit: m; enter only the numerical value.)

solutions.explanation: The two straight sections have a total length of \(2\times100=200\) m, so the total length of the two bends is \(400-200=200\) m.
solutions.title: Subtract the straight sections
